name: Subsidized Scheme for Widows: Haryana Women Development Corporation
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Haryana Domiciled Widow, Divorced, and Legally Separated Women. Through this scheme, a subsidy on the total loan is provided.
descriptionMd: The scheme "Subsidized Scheme for Widows" by the Women & Child Development Department, Haryana Government, aims to provide financial assistance to Haryana-domiciled widows, divorced, and Legally Separated Women. Through this scheme, a subsidy on the total loan is provided. The scheme is covered without collateral security by the bank. The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Women Development Corporation.
benefitsMd:
1. A 25% flat subsidy, subject to a maximum of ₹50,000/-, will be provided on the total loan (not as a capital subsidy). 1. The beneficiary's share is 10% of the total loan. 1. The maximum loan limit is ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The scheme will be covered under without collateral security by the bank. 1. The balance amount will be covered from commercial/nationalised banks.
> **Mode of Disbursement:** The balance amount will be covered from commercial/nationalised banks. > **Moratorium Period:** The moratorium period will be three months after disbursement of the loan.
eligibilityMd: 1. The applicant must be a Haryana-domiciled widow, divorced, or a legally separated Woman. 1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/- per annum. 1. The age of the prospective beneficiary should be between 18 and 55 years at the time of applying for the loan.
exclusionsMd: 1. No subsidy for interest accrued on a delayed period will be allowed in case of default of payment of EMI.
applicationMd: > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number & password. Click on ‘Submit’. **Step 3:** Verify the OTP received in the provided Email and Mobile Number. Alternatively, click on the Verification Link to activate the profile. > **Login to Apply for the Scheme:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** The “Sign in here” option is available on the right side of the screen.
